case: The report's publisher prepared the finish; a result was posted after the report; the coordinator began compacting; another seat's prepare took the finish over and resolved the result in one batch at the new generation.
design: docs/adr/0015 decision 6: a holder that is compacting is unavailable, and the next seat to ask for the finish takes it over at the next generation.
docs/adr/0015 "Preparing the finish": a prepare takes the lease as a done does, a takeover included, and keeps the earliest boundary; a batch carries the generation it was made at.
docs/adr/0015 decision 10: once every late item has a typed resolution nothing holds the coordinator's done on what is late.
